channel.title: Tech support guides — the ohgeeceee network
channel.description: Plain-language fixes for the tech around a rural home.

item.title: Fix "No Service" and SOS Mode on Your Phone in Rural Areas
item.description: Your phone says No Service or shows SOS only. Nine things to try, in order, before you assume there is no signal at all.

item.title: Satellite Internet Slow or Dropping Out (Starlink & HughesNet)
item.description: Why satellite internet slows down, drops out, and stalls in bad weather — and the settings and placement fixes that actually help.

item.title: Boost Home Wi-Fi Across a Large House and Outbuildings
item.description: Get Wi-Fi to the far bedroom, the shop, and the barn without buying the wrong gadget. Where to put the router, and when a mesh or a bridge is the right call.

item.title: Clear Cache, Cookies and Pop-Ups in Any Browser
item.description: A slow, cluttered browser and constant pop-ups are usually the same problem. Clear the right things in Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox without losing your passwords.

item.title: Password Recovery and Setting Up a Password Manager with 2FA
item.description: Get back into a locked account, then set up a password manager and two-factor so it never happens again. Written for people who have never used one.

item.title: Quick Fixes for an Extremely Slow Computer or Laptop
item.description: The eight things that actually speed up a slow Windows PC or Mac, in order of effort — from what starts automatically to the drive that is quietly full.

item.title: Connect a Smart TV or Streaming Stick to Weak Wi-Fi
item.description: Stop the buffering on a smart TV or streaming stick that sits too far from the router. The settings that help, and the cheap cable that beats all of them.

item.title: Spot and Avoid Phishing Scams, Text Spam and Robocalls
item.description: The five tells that give away a scam message, plus how to cut down spam texts and robocalls and what to do if you already clicked.

item.title: Set Up a Wireless Printer and Fix Printer Offline Errors
item.description: Get a wireless printer onto your network once and keep it there. Plus the offline-error fixes, in order, when it drops off again.

item.title: Move Your Photos and Files to a New Device and Set Up Cloud Backup
item.description: Get everything off the old phone or computer and onto the new one without losing photos — then set up a backup that actually runs on its own.
